name: Granja de Rocamora (Spain)
description: Dark red field with a narrow yellow border, charged at the centre with a yellow cross and in the four corners with the crowned municipal arms of Granja de Rocamora.
history: Municipal flag of Granja de Rocamora; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Granja de Rocamora arms in the four corners
